source.title: Receive observed SonicScore as actual A2A/x402 hired music and Foley rendering
source.body:
## Demand and source evidence
Leader wants reusable Foley, soundscapes and adaptive scoring across MetroPlat and the 561 ecosystem, **also sellable as A2A/x402 hired work**.

The original product-side planning and scored-event compiler now live under [Resonator #3](https://github.com/red-cup-engineering/resonator/issues/3) and [merged PR #4](https://github.com/red-cup-engineering/resonator/pull/4). Music Engineering is the *existing* owner of performance specs, adaptive stems and its already operational-source `src/service/http-server.mjs` `POST /generate` WAV worker; **not** a second domain renderer.

### Original Music Engineering receiving requirements
- Receive and test real Resonator score JSON from its published version using native `scoreToResonatorSpec`; bridge time/voice events into Music Engineering's **original** performance-spec/rendertoWAV pipeline. Don't reimplement DSP or fork Resonator cue recipes. Distinguish interactive short Foley, bounded environmental episodes and genuine continuous adaptive score. State which output formats are truly rendered: current service supports WAV and structured composition, not speculative codecs.
- Provide a real `SonicScoreJob` with typed source refs and rights, seed, scope, activity coverage, requested output kind (`score-json` or `audio-wav`), explicit duration/CPU/byte ceilings, cancellation/idempotency and durable artifact reference. Sourcing/authorization is separate from an agent merely asserting a prompt.
- Add measured `renderMs`, CPU time where measurable, sample rate, duration, note count, bytes, peak/RMS and source/version receipts to the output **after** actual rendering. Never label estimates as usage, settlement or receipts.
- A2A 1.0 skills via the **existing** [A2A Services Section](https://github.com/red-cup-engineering/a2a-services-section): signed Agent Card, SendMessage/GetTask/CancelTask, work artifacts; reconcile interruptions/retries in the original state owner and test an independent client. Advertise only implemented operations.
- Paid route via the **existing** [x402 Services Section](https://github.com/red-cup-engineering/x402-services-section) challenge, verification and settlement, not bespoke blockchain middleware. Quote and cap before expensive worker compute; distinguish verified payment, render success, refund/cancel disposition, and result access. Merchant listing and seller discovery stay with [Causeway market.561.group](https://github.com/causeway-services/market.561.group), under [x402 issue #8](https://github.com/red-cup-engineering/x402-services-section/issues/8).
- Consumption: real MetroPlat Console receiving is [Console #19](https://github.com/red-cup-engineering/metroplat-operations-console/issues/19); service must work beyond MetroPlat without inheriting MUD-specific semantics.

### Independent acceptance, not assumed
At least one real external A2A client completes a bounded audio/score task with real artifact and cancellation/idempotency behavior, and one real x402 buyer successfully pays, receives the warranted artifact and gets auditable meter and settlement disposition. Publish no SKU until those operations exist. First economic release should favor a fixed-cap JSON score/short Foley product before variable-cost long-form rendering.

comments.author: emsenn
comments.text: **Variable-cost x402 acceptance refinement.** For a SonicScoreJob whose total downstream compute is uncertain, quote a hard maximum and obtain authorized prepayment for that cap. Record each conditional downstream A2A/x402 supplier call (or skipped branch), the verified settled amount and actual billable rendering meters. The final result must contain a bounded invoice/receipt showing cap, actual charges, and unused portion with a **verifiable refund or explicitly outstanding refund liability**; do not claim a refund merely because a local counter says unused. Keep irreversible work and cancellation semantics explicit. This is product-specific composition of the *existing* payment, task and accounting boundaries, not a new facilitator or a claim the current x402 SDK supports generic automatic refunds.
